caption: The drawing features three main objects, rendered with both color and pencil outlines. In the upper-central area, there is a predominantly square brooch or pin with a gold-colored border and a pin stem extending leftward. Inside the square frame is a grayscale profile illustration of an elderly man with long hair, dressed in period clothing, visible from the shoulders up. Below and slightly to the right of this brooch, there is an outline of the square frame viewed from the back, drawn in pencil without color, also showing the location of the pin stem. To the right of this outline, there is a side profile of the same brooch in color, displaying the thickness of the frame and the cameo-like raised profile of the man's face in grayscale and tan on a yellowish background. Lines are drawn connecting the front and side views of the brooch to the outlined back view. The background is plain beige. The dimensions “3 1/20 – 1 7/8 x 1 1/4” and the name “Grace Halpin” are written in pencil near the bottom right corner.
title: Cameo Brooch
